lines.text: Two people. Same salary. A hundred fifty K a year.
One spends it on the life everyone sees.
The parties. The trips. The hundred-twenty-thousand-dollar car.
That car alone? About two grand a month.
The other drives a forty-thousand-dollar car. Six eighty a month.
And quietly invests the other thirteen hundred. Every month.
Ten years later, the party's over.
And one of them is two hundred thirty-six thousand dollars richer.
Same salary. One looked rich. One got rich. Which one are you?
